ModifyIGAutoScaler.minReplicas: Minimum replica count. Valid values: non-negative integers. Default: 0.
ModifyIGAutoScaler.maxReplicas: Maximum replica count. Valid values: non-negative integers. Must be greater than minReplicas.
ModifyIGAutoScaler.scalingGroupPriority: Scaling group priority. Valid values: non-negative integers. Default: 0.
